description.narrative:
The "STEP IN 2 EU" programme aims to lay the groundwork for a resilient and forward-looking Ukrainian economy, particularly as the country pursues integration into the European Union. The overarching impact objective is to improve the framework conditions necessary for Ukraine’s economic recovery and sustainable growth, ensuring the economy is robust against the challenges posed by ongoing conflict and capable of seizing future opportunities.
At the outcome level, the project is focused on enhancing the economic policy environment to facilitate the integration of Ukrainian businesses into the EU single market, including expanding their access to financing options. This involves creating an enabling environment where businesses can adapt to new regulatory standards, tap into EU markets, and attract investment.
To achieve these goals, the project is structured around four key outputs: 1. Strengthening institutional capacities of core economic policy actors, such as the Ministry of Economy, the National Bank of Ukraine, and other relevant agencies, to formulate and implement reforms for EU market integration. 2. Improving the implementation of economic policy reforms, supporting both businesses and financial institutions as they adapt to EU single market requirements. 3. Enhancing local conditions in prioritized sectors—such as food processing, wood products and furniture, textiles and apparel, electrical equipment, and ICT—within selected regions, thereby fostering region-specific development and competitiveness. 4. Building the capacity of financial institutions to provide relevant and accessible financial services to Ukrainian businesses, helping them invest in modernization and expansion.
Gender equality is reflected through a dedicated gender analysis in the preparatory phase, the integration of a gender perspective in the problem analysis and measures to promote women’s economic participation and representation of women in project activities.
